title: DeepSeek-R1 joins the text model roster
summary:
A community-facing day: DeepSeek-R1 arrived, lost projects returned, and sharing your own project got a proper submission path.

DeepSeek-R1 was added to the available models, giving builders another reasoning model behind the same simple text endpoint. Model plumbing: mostly invisible until it gives your app a new brain.

The projects section lost in the previous UI update was restored. A GitHub issue template now gives community projects a consistent path into the showcase instead of relying on archaeology and good intentions.

The site footer now identifies pollinations as Berlin-based and open source. Small metadata, useful signal: the garden has coordinates and its gates are not locked.
